parity_gaps.summary: No licensed, row-level external benchmark denominator is pinned; the 43 selected calibration labels provide neither recall nor SemiAnalysis-equivalent precision, feature, or field parity.

The expanded official open seed, planning and permit review lanes, structural shortlist, footprint context, and satellite review still do not establish a complete global construction census; the accepted Unknown033 recovery is review-only and promotes no source batch or site claim.

Public planning, permit, and environmental-opinion observations do not resolve separate commercial, interconnection, utility, parcel, permit-detail, and mixed-rights raw-detail lanes; excluded assessed country lanes remain outside the current ledger.

Unknown030 remains the current incomplete source batch with 2,086 pending catalog jobs. The accepted Unknown033 wrapper separately reconciles 25 clean terminal jobs into a non-additive review-only recovered state with 2,061 pending; it does not promote Unknown031 or exhaust candidate-level manual verification.

Resolution links remain advisory; England, Ireland, NSW, Netherlands, New Zealand, and France observations plus selected imagery labels are not cross-source deduplicated, no merges are accepted, and unique physical sites remain null.

Type, operating model, typed capacity, power, annual energy, PUE, and workload remain sparse and source-scoped; planned critical-IT values are not current load, generation and grid metrics stay distinct, NSW retains 10 untyped statements, and review lanes promote no ungrounded facility metrics.
